scriptWithTimestamps:
00:00:00:00 - 00:00:04:23
First, use case build a weekly market
intelligence report fully automated.

00:00:04:24 - 00:00:06:13
Set up your e-commerce scraping

00:00:06:13 - 00:00:10:19
tool task to run on a weekly schedule,
then connect it to Sapir.

00:00:10:20 - 00:00:14:24
When the task finishes, Xabier pulls
the data set, sends it to Google Sheets

00:00:14:24 - 00:00:18:21
so you have a historical record,
and then passes the data to an AI.

00:00:18:22 - 00:00:19:21
Step.

00:00:19:21 - 00:00:23:20
That AI step compares this week's results
with last week's in generates

00:00:23:20 - 00:00:25:00
an executive summary.

00:00:25:00 - 00:00:26:22
Are there new products in the category?

00:00:26:22 - 00:00:29:08
Have any competitors changed their prices?

00:00:29:08 - 00:00:33:18
A rating shifting up or down,
or new sellers entering the top spots?

00:00:33:24 - 00:00:36:24
Zapier then emails
that summary straight to your inbox.

00:00:37:00 - 00:00:40:01
You wake up Monday morning with a market
briefing ready to go.

00:00:40:02 - 00:00:42:06
No manual work involved.

00:00:42:06 - 00:00:45:06
Second use case. Product gap analysis.

00:00:45:08 - 00:00:48:07
Use the
AI analysis step to scan product titles

00:00:48:07 - 00:00:51:11
and descriptions
for specific attributes and features.

00:00:51:11 - 00:00:55:08
Compare what are highlighting
against your own catalog.

00:00:55:13 - 00:00:59:11
If three out of five competitors mentioned
noise cancellation in their midrange

00:00:59:13 - 00:01:03:19
headphones and you haven't added it,
that's a feature gap worth addressing.

00:01:03:20 - 00:01:06:24
If you see a price tier with high demand
but only 1

00:01:06:24 - 00:01:09:24
or 2 products,
that's an opportunity to fill.
